body.name: \omega^{\mathrm K}
body.type: pair of conditional response-type probability vectors
body.def: \(\omega_x^{\mathrm K}=\bigl(P_{\vartheta}(U=4\mid X=x),P_{\vartheta}(U=2\mid X=x),P_{\vartheta}(U=3\mid X=x),P_{\vartheta}(U=1\mid X=x)\bigr)\) for \(x\in\{0,1\}\).
body.role: conditional response-type weights recovered by the simultaneous equations in the proof of Kawakami (2021), Theorem 1
